email.subject: MV CALDER SOUND - Port report Santos - aft crane out of use
email.body:
Port report, Santos, 25 Jan 2025.

The aft crane, serving holds 4 and 5, stopped with a slewing gear fault at 1310 UTC on 24 Jan. Loading at those holds stopped; the gang stood by. Shore technicians repaired the slewing gear and the crane was back at work at 0140 UTC today. The forward cranes worked throughout.

Estimated completion of loading now 26 Jan 1800 UTC.

Master MV CALDER SOUND

output.off_hire_clause: Off hire (fictional, modelled on NYPE 1993 clause 17): in the event of loss of time from breakdown of, or damage to, hull, machinery or equipment, or any other similar cause preventing the full working of the vessel, the payment of hire shall cease for the time thereby lost. All bunkers used by the vessel while off hire shall be for the owners' account. Rider (fictional): in the event of a breakdown of the vessel's cargo cranes, hire shall be reduced pro rata for the time lost, in the proportion that the number of cranes out of use bears to the total number of cranes.
output.war_risks_clause: War risks (fictional, modelled on BIMCO CONWARTIME 2013): the vessel shall not be obliged to proceed through any area where, in the reasonable judgement of the Master and/or the owners, she may be exposed to war risks. If the owners so decide, the charterers shall give other orders, and the vessel shall proceed by an alternative route. Extra time and bunkers on that route are for the charterers' account.

result.result:
The aft crane was out of use from 1310 UTC on 24 Jan to 0140 UTC on 25 Jan (12.5 hours). According to the simulated hire statement, the hire deduction for this period with one crane out of use is USD 1,562.50. Based on the CP off-hire clause and its rider, since the breakdown stopped loading at holds 4 and 5, the ship is off hire pro rata for the time lost in proportion to the number of cranes out of use.

The operator should decide whether to put the ship off hire pro rata and notify the owner. If agreed, the following would follow: (a) a voyage management system entry for the off-hire period with the cranes out of use, and (b) an e-mail to the owner's vessel technical management giving the period, the crane and the reason. I recommend that nothing be sent until the operator answers.
